headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty closed 0.5% higher as IT and pharma stocks rallied.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Tuesday, 3 November.

why: IT and pharma stocks rallied, driving a 0.5% gain in Sensex and Nifty during the last trading session.
Weekly performance showed SENSEX and NIFTY50 rising 2% overall, with NIFTY Smallcap 100 jumping 4%.
Reliance buying and foreign inflows contributed positively to market momentum.
Key stocks including TCS, Trent, Bharti Airtel, and BSE delivered over 10% returns in October.
whatHappening: Muthoot Finance reported a 27% rise in Q2 profit to ₹2,977 crore with income increasing by 37%.
EKA Mobility announced plans for a ₹1,000-crore R&D investment to expand capacity by 2030.
Radico Khaitan is targeting Scotland to secure supplies of malt whisky.
Indian stock market benchmarks rebounded from earlier losses ahead of the upcoming week.
summary: On the last trading day, Sensex and Nifty closed 0.5% higher led by gains in IT and pharma sectors. Major benchmark indices gained 2% for the week with Trent leading the market rally. Markets are closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Tuesday, 3 November.
